scripts.dev: pnpm run prebuild && wrangler dev --env local -c wrangler.jsonc -c test/fixtures-worker/wrangler.jsonc --port ${KITESURF_PORT:-8787} --inspector-port ${KITESURF_INSPECTOR_PORT:-9229}
scripts.dev:wpt: pnpm run prebuild && wrangler dev --env local -c wrangler.jsonc -c test/fixtures-worker/wrangler.jsonc --port ${KITESURF_PORT:-8787} --inspector-port ${KITESURF_INSPECTOR_PORT:-9229} --var KITESURF_DISABLE_PRECISE_TIMERS:1
scripts.dev:simulate-prod: pnpm run prebuild && wrangler dev --env local -c wrangler.jsonc -c test/fixtures-worker/wrangler.jsonc --port ${KITESURF_PORT:-8787} --inspector-port ${KITESURF_INSPECTOR_PORT:-9229} --var KITESURF_SIMULATE_PROD_EVAL:1
scripts.cf-typegen: wrangler types -c wrangler.jsonc --include-runtime --no-strict-vars && wrangler types -c test/fixtures-worker/wrangler.jsonc --include-runtime --no-strict-vars test/fixtures-worker/worker-configuration.d.ts
scripts.types: pnpm run cf-typegen && tsc --noEmit && tsc --noEmit -p test/e2e/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p test/e2e/demos/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p test/fixtures-worker/tsconfig.json
